hooks.command:
prompt="$(jq -r '.prompt // empty' | perl -0777 -pe 's{<(ide_opened_file|ide_selection|system-reminder|command-[a-z]+|local-command-stdout) .*?</\1>}{}gs; s/\A\s+//; s/\s+\z//;')"; [ -n "$prompt" ] && printf '

## %s — Prompt

%s
' "$(date '+%F %T')" "$prompt" >> "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/sessions.md"

tp="$(jq -r '.transcript_path // empty')"; [ -f "$tp" ] || exit 0; for i in $(seq 1 30); do n="$(tail -1 "$tp" | jq -r 'select(.type=="assistant") | ([.message.content[]?|select(.type=="text")]|length) // 0' 2>/dev/null)"; { [ -n "$n" ] && [ "$n" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; } && break; sleep 0.1; done; resp="$(jq -rRn '[inputs|fromjson?] as $all | def isPrompt: .type=="user" and ((.message.content|type)=="string" or ((.message.content|type)=="array" and ((any(.message.content[]?;.type=="tool_result"))|not))); (([range(0;($all|length))|select($all[.]|isPrompt)]|last)//-1) as $s | [$all[($s+1):][]|select(.type=="assistant")|.message.content[]?|select(.type=="text")|.text]|join("

")' "$tp" 2>/dev/null)" && [ -n "$resp" ] && printf '
### Assistant

%s

---
' "$resp" >> "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/sessions.md"
